evals.prompt: Génère une image d'un phare breton au coucher du soleil, style photo argentique.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks the machine, picks an image tool and model, gets the estimate (exit 2) and asks the user before spending, then generates with --spend and gives the path and the real cost.
expectations: Runs `media.mjs doctor` before any other command of the skill
Runs the image command without --spend first and reads the estimate
Asks the user with AskUserQuestion, giving the price in USD and the model, before any --spend
Runs again with --spend set to the estimate only after the user's yes
Gives the output path and the cost printed by the command
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Anime cette photo avec un dolly zoom sur le sujet : ../video-editor/engine/test/assets/photo.png
evals.expected_output: The video tool dolly-zoom-in with the photo as first frame, the estimate asked first, then the job run and waited for.
expectations: Finds the tool with `media.mjs tools video --search` (dolly)
Asks before spending, with the price in USD
Waits for the video job (background or long timeout) and reports the file

evals.prompt: Traduis cette vidéo en anglais et en espagnol : ../video-editor/engine/test/speech.mp4
evals.expected_output: The audio translate tool through ElevenLabs, the estimate in credits, the user's yes, and no lip-sync said.
expectations: Gives the price in ElevenLabs credits
Offers dubbing_v1 as the cheaper choice against dubbing_v2
Never runs with --spend before the user's yes

evals.prompt:
media-generator — Copy prompt
Space: video · Tool: orbit (Orbit) · Model: openrouter:kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro
Fields: subject=a perfume bottle on black marble, direction=right, arc=a half turn
Inputs: first_frame=/tmp/bottle.png
What I want: a luxurious slow product reveal
Write the best prompt for this model, then run: media.mjs draft --space video --tool orbit --model openrouter:kwaivgi/kling-v3.0-pro --prompt "…" — do not generate.
evals.expected_output: A model-specific prompt written into the dashboard's draft, nothing generated and nothing spent.

Never runs `media.mjs video` and never passes --spend
Tells the user to use the Reload bar in the dashboard
